summary: The app builds, launches, and populates the full UIA tree (structural coverage 6/6 and 4/4) but renders a completely blank white window in the automated-capture session. Root cause is scaffold-added composition-dependent chrome (ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar + the new TitleBar control) that survived the agent's Mica-backdrop removal. Action deadness is hardware-gated (0 LampArrays attached in both UWP and WinUI) and not a regression.
